rows.name: PAUSE_LEN_NS

rows.values: `tpause` selects the CPU instruction `tpause`. `none` selects a loop with no pause instruction. Any other text keeps the default. The match is exact.

A label in square brackets on a test case of Catch2, the C++ test framework of the `t_` test programs. A test run can select or exclude test cases by tag.

notes: 24 rows, one for each input variable. None is dropped. 9 rows are hand_set true and 15 rows are fixtures. All 24 rows were checked against the code. Every evidence quote is the source line without its indentation. The 2 quotes of bin/ci/test/test-positron-dice-resource-map.sh:23 stop before the pipe character of that line. Rows changed in meaning: MIXTRAL_PATH, PAUSE_HINT, PAUSE_LEN_NS, PAUSE_TYPE, PERFETTO_CAPTURE_REQUIRE_INTEGRATION, PERFETTO_TEST_BIN_DIR, REAL_CHMOD, REMOVAL_MARKER, REMOVED_DIRECTORY, RINZLER_MODEL_ROOT, RINZLER_PROXY_BIN, RINZLER_REMOTE_TEST_ENV, RZ_TABLE_REPEAT. The other changed rows differ in wording, term or cell format only. The fixture rows now use the term fake and the read_by form of the chunks tests-02 and tests-03: the reader, then the test file in parentheses. The term stub is gone from the cells. The variable name STUB_CMAKE_VERSION stays as it is in the code. Facts without an evidence object, because the limit is 4 objects: the pass limits in the PAUSE_TYPE notes (t/t_mwaitx.cpp:840-846), the deadline sentences in the PAUSE_LEN_NS notes (t/t_mwaitx.cpp:808 and :821, h/system/mwaitx.hpp:61), the tag and the make targets in the MIXTRAL_PATH notes (t/t_tokenizers.cpp:780, GNUmakefile:1061), and the skip in the RINZLER_PROXY_BIN notes (t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py:3747-3748). The change list names each site. Decisions for the assembler: RZ_TABLE_REPEAT stays in the group other. t_rinzler has the CTest label fpga, so the group hardware also fits. REAL_CHMOD has 3 setter files. set_in names bin/ci/test-shared-nfs.sh and the notes cell names the other 2 files. RINZLER_MODEL_ROOT stays as a fixture row. No TRON program reads it. PERFETTO_TEST_BIN_DIR stays in the group tool-tests. Its test covers the Perfetto launcher scripts, which are tools and not CI scripts, so the group other also fits. POS_VERBOSE_TEST stays hand_set true. It has no visible effect in this snapshot, and the row says so. Bash behaviour for an unset name (the messages parameter null or not set and unbound variable) and the export of a prefix assignment into a shell function were checked with standalone statements on bash 5.1.16, outside the checkout.
